svg.title: Pipeline Selection — render_pipelines
svg.text: Pipeline Selection (VERIFIZIERT gegen Pipelines.lua — mmd source in pipeline-selection.mmd)

text.tspan: Mod register render_pipeline (id, label, levels OFF/15/35/50, priority, available, gate) → Data.merge + _owners
→ PipelineAdapter.install (priority sort) → save.options.pipelines persistent → pro Frame update(dt)
→ worldPipeline = highest priority where eligible = level>0 && !broken && available()==true (gate NICHT geprüft)
→ keine eligible → Fallback vanilla 2D (TileRenderer+SpriteRenderer) / gefunden → guardRender: pushAll → drawWorld ctx → popAll → isCanvas
→ canvas|null → Fallback 2D / throw → broken=true attribuiert an ownerOf(id) → Fallback 2D (nie Crash)
→ canvas → worldPresent fold (alle eligible with worldPresent, isCanvas each) → present fold
Input: Hotkey 6 → canToggle? gate(top,overworld)==true → cycle OFF→15→35→50→OFF + excludeTilt (andere drawWorld→0)
Resize / Memory critical → invalidate() leert GPU/Data/Image → Fallback 2D
available probe: Canvas exists? true / WebGL2 in WebView? async cached (invalidate löscht) / Headless false
Render in GitHub via Mermaid block in docs/ARCHITEKTUR.md §73.7b — SVG ist Fallback; echt via `npx mmdc -i .mmd -o .svg`
